headline: The Election Commission of Pakistan said on Friday that allocating party tickets is an internal matter for political parties and it has no legal authority to make them field women on winnable general seats, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Only Parliament can change the law, ECP tells NA panel

caption:
ECP says it cannot make parties give women winnable seats! 🗳️
According to Dawn, the Election Commission of Pakistan said on Friday that allocating party tickets is an internal matter for political parties and it has no legal authority to intervene. It told a sub-committee of the National Assembly's Special Committee on Gender Mainstreaming that Section 206 of the Elections Act, 2017 only requires parties to give at least 5 per cent of their general-seat tickets to women, and that fielding women on winnable seats would need new legislation by Parliament. The ECP also said no woman had filed nomination papers for 563 vacant local government seats.
